events.title: Erehwon Demo ver 0.8.6 Release
events.summary: The following fixes have been implementedFixed an issue where data for acquired equipment was sometimes corrupted.Added a feature to display a minimap inside dungeons.The minimap will appear when you turn on “Display Minimap” in the settings.Changed the UI that appears when you acquire an item.Added a feature to view equipment details on the equipment screen.Also fixed minor bugs.

events.title: Erehwon Demo ver 0.8.5 Release
